findings.title: Add regression coverage for rejecting SQL expressions
findings.body: This change is the primary guard that rejects SQL expressions during query parsing, but no tests are added to verify that SQL queries are rejected with the feature flag both enabled and disabled, or that other expression types still parse. Without automated coverage, a later change could accidentally restore SQL expression handling and reintroduce the vulnerability without failing CI.
